avoid_for: Content-heavy SaaS dashboards, brand-first storytelling sites needing imagery or illustration, playful consumer brands, or dark-mode products — the 1% colorfulness and white-marble quiet fail when color or content density is required.
best_for: Type foundries, font marketplaces, and gallery-like product catalogues where the product itself is typography — a near-monochrome museum register with one coral action color and specimen-first layout.
name: Discover
palette_voice: Near-monochrome white marble: Canvas (#ffffff) with warm near-black Ink (#121212) for all text and borders (never pure #000), Slate (#8e8e93) for metadata, and a single Signal Coral (#ee585a) reserved strictly for filled CTAs, inline links, the floating filter pill, and a notification dot — never a background wash, never on large surfaces; the only shadow is one ambient token (rgba(72,72,74,0.16) 0 2px 32px 0) for cards and floating elements.
signature_moves: 120px Aeonik 700 wordmark at -1.32px tracking, near-edge-to-edge on white — the brand name as the hero image
Single 12px Signal Coral notification dot on the wordmark's final letter — one pop of color that says 'new' without a badge
32px border-radius on all cards, buttons, and containers — the large soft radius that defines the modern gallery feel
Oversized 'Aa' type specimens rendered in-card as the product itself, dominating each font preview tile
Ghost text link in Signal Coral with an external-arrow glyph (↗) — the only interactive text color in a monochrome room

source.shadow: single token rgba(72,72,74,0.16) 0 2px 32px 0 — cards & floating elements only

tagline: Type museum on white marble — a near-black wordmark, a whisper of coral, and everything else recedes.
typographic_voice: A single face (Aeonik, subst. Inter/Satoshi) across the whole UI: weight 700 for the monumental 120px wordmark and display, 500 for labels and nav, 400 for body; tight -0.011em tracking at every size gives the packed, dense wordmark look — no loose display tracking, no serifs, no decorative faces, type is the only visual asset.
